name: multiple_choice: Which of the following statements about statistical inference is…

request.questionText: Which of the following statements about statistical inference is accurate? (1) Sampling variance refers to non-systematic (random) differences between estimand and estimate. (2) Sampling bias refers to systematic (non-random) differences between estimand and estimate. (3) Bootstrapping helps us to quantify the statistical uncertainty we have about a sample estimate and what it can tell us about some population estimand.
